about:
# MiniAuras

Features:

- Create custom mini weak aura icon alerts with sound.
- Displays enemy CC on party/raid frames.
- Active cooldowns shown on party/raid frames.
- Show important and defensives on nameplates.
- Important/defensive spell icons on portraits.
- Enemy and ally kick timers.
- Party PvP trinkets.
- Notification of when your healer is in CC.
- Sound alerts of enemy spells.
- Supports many frame addons such as ElvUI, Danders Frames, Ellesmere Frames, etc.
- Available in 10 languages.

Any feedback is more than welcome.

[Discord](https://discord.gg/UruPTPHHxK)

releases.notes:
- Added an All ranks option to personal auras on WoW Forever, so one spell ID tracks every rank of that spell. It is on for new groups.
- Fixed Druid missing from the personal auras spec dropdown on WoW Forever.
- Added ability to add custom spells to the portraits module.

- Fixed crowd control no longer showing on party and raid frames since patch 12.1.5.
- Fixed enemy defensives and important buffs going missing from alerts since patch 12.1.5.
- Fixed the Frame Auras buff row on the target and focus frames going blank on an enemy with the tracked buff list on since patch 12.1.5.
- Fixed a Lua error in arena from patch 12.1.5, which now keeps enemy specs secret.
- Fixed portrait aura icons not filling the whole portrait on EllesmereUI unit frames. The 5.43.3 fix was aimed at ElvUI by mistake and has been undone.
